text:
maria: heads up — prod alert. seeing a spike of cross-region requests for tenant=enterprise-ny. requests are being routed to eu-aux with fallback, latency x3 and cost spike.
ajay: any errors? logs?
maria: 500s from quantized-variant on us-east, fallback kicks to eu-aux. interestingly, us-east still has healthy GPU load. something's wrongly marking variant as unavailable.
lee: can you paste the route decision payload? suspect missing 'probe_ok' flag in telemetry which makes the router treat variant as down.
maria: copied: `{"tenant":"enterprise-ny","requested_variant":"q8_6b","route_decision":"fallback","reason":"quota_exceeded"}` — but quota_exceeded is weird, tenant has reserve.
sam: @lee that 'quota_exceeded' comes from per-variant bucket; I think the meter is using aggregate tokens instead of per-variant tokens after the canary rollout. TL;DR: a metric name change in rollout PR#412 broke the token key.
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-18T08:12:02 PR#412 -> eng-platform/canary (success)
nana: we should throttle the fallback path. currently fallback attempts are unbounded and cause cascade when both origin and aux flip states.
nana: propose: 1) add cooldown per-requester for fallback attempts (3s, exponential), 2) stop counting fallback-failed tokens toward origin quota.
toni: UX: console needs to show 'active fallback chain' and last 10 route decisions per-tenant. right now the dashboard only shows final routed region which hides loops.
lee: quick mitigation: revert PR412 (rollback) or patch router to treat missing probe flag as healthy for 5m. which is less risky?
sam: rollback PR412 (small) + emergency router patch (short-lived) — can do both. I'll open a rollback PR now.
ops-bot: alert incident-3742 created: cross-region-fallback-spike, paged oncall
ajay: also add `route_decision` and `origin_region` to our ingest so the telemetry team can graph transitions — currently we only log final_region.
maria: test curl to debug endpoint: ```curl -H "x-tenant: enterprise-ny" "https://internal-router/debug?path=decisions"``` returns chain.
nana: action items: sam -> rollback PR412 (ETA 30m), lee -> router soft-patch (ETA 15m), toni -> add fallback chain widget to console (mockup by EOD), ajay -> telemetry schema change (ETA 2d).
maria: thanks. I'll keep thread open until last change deployed. :thumbsup:
